records.text: Tyler Robinson called out of work on September 10 to help his grandmother move furniture and on September 11 citing food poisoning.

appearances.snippet: We can also tell you that Tyler Robinson called out of work on the 11th. That's another story I'm breaking here. He was citing food poisoning.
